notes.title: [v1.20] 08.11 updates
notes.content:
v1.20 is here

[*] The attack system has beem improved,now attack enemy is easier!
[*] Camera now rotate with out holding right mouse
[*] The cursor will now confine in the game window
[*] Some levels collision and camera movment have been fixed
[*] Game experience now getting more and more smooth,try it
[/list]

Multiplayer game is on it's way!
ːsteamhappyː
